content: Peniya, nyakukibhona kitabo mu lubhoko lwalelo lwa jwenio jwatamite panane jha kigoda chu unahota nkolongwa, kitabo chenie kijhandikwe nkate na panja na kibhekwite minepo chaba.
Kabhele nganimonita ntumiche jhuna makakala jwa kunane kwa Chapanga akitangicha kanonoha, “Bho, ghane jwahoto kumetula minepo jhene na kuyekula kitabo chenjeno?”
Nambo akibha jhe mundo jhojhoha kunane kwa Chapanga, hilu pannema hilu pahe jha nnema jwakuhoto kuyekula kitabo cheneche na kukilolekeya chikibhii nkate.
Nenga nganelita kwa lipyanda hake nhwalo akibha jhe mundo jwatopila kukiyekula, anda jhe kukilinga nkate.

Kubhoke peniya jhumo pakate jha ighogholo bhala ngalongila, “Mangalela jhe. Dolokeya! Lihimba lilikabila lya Yuda, kibheluko cha Daude, ndi jwahotwile. Ndi nahotola kumetula minepo jhene chaba na kukiyekula kitabo cheneche.”

Peniya, nganimonita Mwanalimbelele ajhemite panakate jha kigoda chenie cha Unahota, intindii ihumbi ina ughome ncheche na ighogholo bhala. Mwanalimbelele jwenio ndi abhonikina ngita achinjitwe. Akibha na manyelo chaba na miho chaba ndi ihuke chaba ya Chapanga ikibha ipelikwe kila chehemo pannema.
Mwanalimbelele ngajhenda, ngatoila kitabo cheneche kubhoka mu lubhoko lwalelo lwa jhola jwatamite pa kigoda cha Unahota.

Papa patoila kitabo cheneche, ina ughome ncheche pamonga na ighogholo makome mabhele na ncheche ngibhikigwihita mangukama palonge jha Mwanalimbelele. Kila mundo akibha na lilimba lyake na bakule jha chaabo jhitwelii ubane. Ubane gwenio ndi ujhopo gwa bhando bha Chapanga.

content.text: Nhwalo mwe mukachinjitwe, na kwa miyahe jhino munkombolii Chapanga,
bhando kuhumii makabila ghoha, na ilonge yoha na ngolo na ilambo yoha.
kupala bhantumikii Chapanga gwito, na bheniya nabhalongocha bhando bha nnema ghoha.”

content: Punolita tu, nganyohina lilobhe lya akatumiche bha kunane kwa Chapanga na abhii jhe mundo jwahotwi kwabhalanga. Bhakibha bhakitindii kigoda cha Unahota nkolongwa pamonga na ihumbi ina ughome ncheche na ighogholo,

content.text: itope kupoke ulumbalilo nkolongwa nhwalo gwa uhotolo gwake, ilebhe mbwe na malango ghake,
makakala ghake na ukolongwa gwake itopela ulumbalilo nkolongwa.”

content: Kubhoke peniya nganyohina kila chikipanginwe kunane kwa Chapanga na pannema na pahe jha nnema na kumbwane na yoha ibhii mwenio ndi nganyohina ikalongila,

content.text: “Kwa jwenio jwaitama pa kigoda cha unahota nkolongwa na kwa Mwanalimbelele,
ibhehe ulumbililo na ukolongwa na uhotolo,

content: Na ihumbi ncheche yela ngailongila, “Chakaka!” Na ighogholo bhala ngabhagwila mangukama, kunnyinamila.
